rules: Use 'Manrope' for all headings to give a modern, technical feel.
Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text for maximum legibility in data-dense views.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for any IP addresses, serial numbers, or code-like data.

structure: Header: Sticky, glassmorphism effect, contains Logo and User Profile.
Summary Section: Grid of 4 cards (Total Branches, Total Cameras, Audio, No Audio).
Analytics Section: Split view (2/3 Bar Chart, 1/3 Pie Chart).
Data Section: Full-width interactive table with search and filters.

cards.style: Flat, 1px border (border-slate-800), no shadow, bg-slate-950/50 backdrop-blur-sm.

buttons.secondary: bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 rounded-md

inputs.style: bg-slate-950 border-slate-800 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 rounded-md

charts.theme: Dark mode optimized, minimal grid lines, vibrant data colors (Blue, Emerald, Amber, Rose)

images.description: Modern corporate building at night for login screen background
Abstract camera technology for empty states or 404 pages

implementation_steps: 2. Theme: Configure 'tailwind.config.js' with the custom color palette (Obsidian/Slate).
3. Layout: Create the main 'DashboardLayout' with a sticky sidebar/header.
4. Components: Customize Shadcn components (Card, Table, Input) to match the 'Tactical' aesthetic (remove heavy shadows, add borders).
5. Features: Implement the Summary Cards, then Charts, then the Data Table.
6. Polish: Add micro-interactions (hover states) and ensure responsive behavior.
universal_guidelines: DO NOT use generic gradients. Use solid, deep colors.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (WCAG AA).
Avoid 'AI Slop' - make it look engineered, not generated.
Keep the UI dense but legible - this is a monitoring tool.
